mapper.select: select inst_id, inst_name, create_dt, update_dt, inst_address, inst_phone, inst_post, inst_head_name from t1000_institution
mapper.insert: insert into t1000_institution (inst_id, inst_name, create_dt, update_dt, inst_address, inst_phone, inst_post, inst_head_name) values(#{inst_id}, #{inst_name}, #{create_dt}, SYSDATE, #{inst_address}, #{inst_phone}, #{inst_post}, #{inst_head_name})
mapper.update: update t1000_institution set inst_name=#{inst_name}, create_dt=#{create_dt}, update_dt=SYSDATE, inst_address=#{inst_address}, inst_phone=#{inst_phone}, inst_post=#{inst_post}, inst_head_name=#{inst_head_name} where inst_id=#{inst_id}
